name: kibo-vscode
description: Tells your running Kibo desktop companion when a VS Code build or test task starts, succeeds or fails.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reports only task start/finish; never reads workspace content.

kibo.reporting.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, nothing is ever sent to Kibo.

kibo.build.enabled.description: Report VS Code Tasks as builds (started / succeeded / failed).

kibo.build.taskScope.description: Which tasks count as builds. 'buildGroup' = only tasks in the Build group (recommended). 'all' = every non-background task.

kibo.tests.enabled.description: Report tasks in the Test group (started / passed / failed) to Kibo. Reuses Kibo's build reactions; see README.

kibo.diagnostics.enabled.description: Reserved. Kibo's protocol has no diagnostics event, so enabling this currently sends nothing.

kibo.logLevel.description: Output channel 'Kibo' verbosity. The token is never logged.
